messages:
Maya (CS): Quick weekly check-in for Shoreline Private deployment — top items: region health, KMS/HSM alerts, spend + renewal risk. Posting the snapshot + asks.

Liam (EngInfra): Thanks — attaching short stats I pulled: p50 latency (gen) us-east-1=78ms, eu-west-3=112ms, ap-southeast-1=220ms. p95 us-east-1=210ms, eu-west-3=360ms, ap-southeast-1=780ms. Error rate (5xx) last 24h: us-east-1=0.7%, eu-west-3=1.9%, ap-southeast-1=4.2%.

Maya (CS): Noted. Spend flagged: customer's monthly committed usage is being exceeded in ap-southeast-1 — spend jump ~18% MoM due to batch inference there.

Akira (Customer): Confirming — we had a campaign last week in APAC, expect spikes. We can shift noninteractive batches to off-peak or another region if needed.

Raj (Solutions): @Akira can you share the job window and whether KV-cache priming is required? If jobs are tolerant, we can suggest queuing to us-east-1 for cost/latency.

Akira (Customer): Jobs run 02:00–06:00 local, yes they warm the KV cache. We prefer keeping data regional but can route ephemeral batches if redacted.

Liam (EngInfra): KMS/HSM: OpsAlertBot tripped 3 KMS gRPC timeouts in eu-west-3 between 02:12–02:19 UTC yesterday. Logs: `grpc: received unexpected EOF` then `kms: key unwrap timeout 5s`. Fallbacks succeeded, but increased tokenization latency for affected requests.

Sofia (Security): We reviewed the logs — HSM side wasn't unhealthy, looks like an intermittent network blip to the managed KMS endpoint. I've opened a support ticket with the provider and set stricter alerts around unwrap latency. Ticket ID: KB-40921.

Maya (CS): Renewal risk note: utilization across private nodes is uneven. Customer's committed capacity utilization is 42% for reserved GPU pool in ap-southeast-1 — that reduces perceived value. They have a renewal review in 8 weeks. We should propose cost-optimization + training.

Raj (Solutions): Suggested action: 1) run a quick quantization audit for batch workloads, 2) recommend prefix caching for steady prompts, 3) present a revised reserved capacity plan that shifts burstable jobs to shared burst pool. I can draft the proposal.

Liam (EngInfra): For connectivity: a handful of edge nodes in ap-southeast-1 showed elevated connection churn to VPC interconnect yesterday (BFD flaps). Command I ran: `gcloud compute vpn tunnels describe --region=ap-southeast-1 --filter="status=ESTABLISHING"` — output attached in thread (snippet):

```
Tunnel: vpn-01
Status: ESTABLISHING -> CONNECTED
BFD: flap count=6
RTT: 48ms -> 420ms
```

Maya (CS): Thank you. @Liam can we confirm if these were within the customer's managed router or our edge?

Liam (EngInfra): Looks like on their side — their router firmware had a scheduled patch the same window. We should mark as customer-managed but provide mitigation steps.

Sofia (Security): Minor note: recommend we verify KMS key rotation window — customer rotates keys monthly and last rotation coincided with the patch. Could be a timing collision.

Maya (CS): Next steps and owners: 
- Liam: investigate persistent p95 in eu-west-3 + HSM unwrap retry tuning (due date: 48h).
- Raj: draft cost-optimization + reserved capacity shift proposal (due date: 72h).
- Sofia: follow up on KB-40921 with provider and confirm key rotation safety window (due date: 24h).
- Maya: schedule enablement session for their infra team on routing best practices and KMS observability (tentative Wed 10am PT).

Liam (EngInfra): I'll try increasing unwrap retry to 3 and bumping RPC timeout to 8s as a temporary mitigation; monitoring will be enabled.

Raj (Solutions): I'll include toggles they can try: batch window shifting, prefix cache TTL adjustments, and a templated rollout plan for moving ephemeral batches to us-east-1.

Akira (Customer): Appreciate this, Maya/Raj. Enablement session works for Wed 10am PT. For the proposal, please include estimated cost delta (baseline vs shifted) and any impact on latency.

Maya (CS): Will do. Quick FYI: deploy-bot reports a canary rollout to the ap-southeast-1 inference pool at 1976542800 — successful. No related alerts post-rollout.

deploy-bot: canary deploy completed: pool=ap-southeast-1, image=rdw-infer:v3.2.1, duration=4m12s :white_check_mark:

OpsAlertBot: alert suppressed for KMS unwrap latency during maintenance window (permanent=false).

Maya (CS): Closing with ask: everyone update the shared runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/shoreline-private-health with the notes above after your tasks. I'll pull together the renewal-risk slide for next week.

Liam (EngInfra): Acknowledged.

Sofia (Security): Acknowledged, will update KB and confirm timeline with provider.

Raj (Solutions): On it — will post draft proposal in this thread when ready.

Akira (Customer): Thanks team.

Maya (CS): End of weekly thread."
